banner.lost: Your dictation shortcut stopped working. Wispr Bro needs Accessibility access again.

sheet.title: Fix your shortcut
sheet.introPermission: macOS turned off Wispr Bro's Accessibility access, so it can't notice your shortcut. This can happen after an update or when the entry was changed in System Settings.
sheet.introStopped: Wispr Bro's keyboard listener stopped. It restarts on its own as soon as macOS allows it.
sheet.pictureLabel: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility: the Wispr Bro row with its switch turned on
sheet.step1: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.
sheet.step2: Turn on Wispr Bro. If it is already on, turn it off and on again.
sheet.step3: Come back here. The shortcut works again within a few seconds, without restarting.
sheet.resetBody: After an update, macOS can keep an old entry that no longer matches the app. Reset removes Wispr Bro's entry so you can allow it again.
sheet.resetStep2: Allow Wispr Bro when macOS asks, or turn it on in the list that opens.
sheet.resetFailed: Couldn't reset the entry. In the list, select Wispr Bro and remove it with the minus button, then add it again with the plus button.

status.needsRelaunch: Access is back. Relaunch Wispr Bro to finish.
